Summary

UI/UX & product designer and web developer with 5+ years of experience designing and building AI products, B2B SaaS dashboards, websites and mobile apps for startups and companies in the USA, UK, EU, Singapore and Saudi Arabia.

Currently Lead Product Designer for a B2B procurement platform, working directly with leadership from strategy to developer handoff. Alongside full-time roles, I've worked with 350+ international clients. I design and develop end to end: from research and Figma design to live websites built in Framer, Webflow, WordPress or custom code, using AI tools like Claude to prototype and ship faster. I also run monthly marketing kits: short reels, social media posts and ad creatives.
